'''Mos Elrey''' was a settlement within the small inhabited portion of the [[desert]] [[planet]] [[Tatooine]]'s northern hemisphere.<ref name="CVD" /> It was located on the eastern edge of the [[Western Dune Sea]] near the south western edge of the [[Jundland Wastes]]. The settlement of [[Mos Espa]] stood 108 [[kilometer]]s (67.5 miles) to the north of Mos Elrey, while the distance to the settlement of [[Mos Eisley]] from Mos Elrey was 129.6 kilometers (81 miles) to the east.<ref name="CL" />

{{City-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Mos Elrey was first mentioned in the [[2016]] reference book [[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2016)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']], where it was newly added as one of several modifications to maps<ref name="CL" /> that had originally been created for the [[2000]] reference book ''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Episode I]]''<ref name="Inside Episode I">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Episode I]]''</ref> and the [[2005]] [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] reference book ''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars Trilogy]]''<ref name="Inside OT">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars Trilogy]]''</ref>
